# windows_timezone (Data Source)

Reads the current system time zone state of the remote Windows host without managing it. This is a **singleton** data source — no lookup keys are required.

Exposes `timezone_id`, `display_name`, `base_utc_offset` (standard offset), `supports_daylight_saving_time`, `current_utc_offset` (live effective offset), `daylight_saving_disabled` and `tzautoupdate_enabled`.

The Terraform data source ID is the stable `machine_id` (HKLM MachineGuid).

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    windows = {
      source  = "kfrlabs/windows"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

provider "windows" {
  host     = var.windows_host
  username = var.windows_username
  password = var.windows_password
}

# Singleton — no lookup keys required.
data "windows_timezone" "current" {}

output "timezone_id" {
  value = data.windows_timezone.current.timezone_id
}

output "current_utc_offset" {
  value = data.windows_timezone.current.current_utc_offset
}

output "id" {
  value = data.windows_timezone.current.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `base_utc_offset` (String) Standard (non-DST) UTC offset of the zone, formatted as `+HH:mm`.
- `current_utc_offset` (String) Live effective UTC offset (base plus the active DST delta, if any), formatted as `+HH:mm`.
- `daylight_saving_disabled` (Boolean) Whether daylight saving time is disabled for the zone (`tzutil <id>_dstoff`).
- `display_name` (String) Localized display name of the configured time zone.
- `id` (String) Data source ID; the stable machine ID (HKLM MachineGuid).
- `supports_daylight_saving_time` (Boolean) Whether the zone definition includes daylight saving time.
- `timezone_id` (String) Configured Windows time zone ID (e.g. `Romance Standard Time`).
- `tzautoupdate_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the `tzautoupdate` service may change the time zone automatically.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
